observations.body: After taking his garments and reclining again, Jesus interprets the washing through servant and master relations, blessed action, the bread-sharing Scripture, foretelling, and receiving sent messengers.
observations.label: Teacher and Lord interprets the washing as an example

observations.body: The passage presents Washing one another’s feet as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Washing one another’s feet

observations.body: The passage places Psalm 41 applied to the bread-sharing betrayer beside Washing one another’s feet.
observations.label: Psalm 41 applied to the bread-sharing betrayer

payload.posture: Read John 13:12–20 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states after taking his garments and reclining again, Jesus interprets the washing through servant and master relations, blessed action, the bread-sharing Scripture, foretelling, and receiving sent messengers. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
payload.title: Teacher and Lord interprets the washing as an example
